protocol.model_identity_limit: Mutable alias, not fixed weights or verified training cutoff
protocol.aggregation: Each month/repeat separately, equal cell average; Q9 headline-style center is median of individually fitted density means, not a nationwide headline.
protocol.sampling: Fixed-seed subsample of each frozen 48-person roster:14 High and10 Low; Low oversampled for mechanism coverage, no current target answers used.
protocol.auxiliary_weights: Original SCE weight multiplied by within-parent stratum inverse inclusion probability; main paired analysis unweighted and equal-month. Neither implies national representativeness.
protocol.comparison: All arms retain original High/Low. Detailed arms add seven historical actual quiz responses. Only detailed-arm contrast isolates presentation.
protocol.primary_contrast: faithful_paraphrase minus question_answer on individual density-IQR paired MAE
protocol.exploratory_probability_shape: Half the L1 distance between respondent ten-bin probability vectors, in probability percentage points (0-100); not inflation-rate percentage points. Also retain per-cell mean-bin profiles.
protocol.candidate_gate: For a given detailed-vs-label contrast: IQR-MAE upper exploratory 95% bound <0, center MAE and cross-section W1 point changes <=0, each arm valid/scorable >=99%. Pilot continuation, not confirmed success.
protocol.intervals: Paired person-cluster bootstrap, same person retained across months and both generation repeats; equal month and repeat weights. All contrast intervals exploratory, no confirmatory multiplicity claim.
protocol.support: All three arms and both repeats must be scorable for each retained person-month; report excluded assigned rows. Validity below99%: accuracy descriptions only, no successful-effect inference.
protocol.truth_isolation: Preparation reads only existing roster/P/E/previous beliefs and whitelist historical quiz columns; current Q8/Q9 are never parsed here. Truth file is pinned by hash for separate evaluation.
protocol.cognitive_sources: Each item taken from the same respondent strictly before target month; missing/unmapped is explicit; no standard answer, feedback, correct/incorrect labels or invented psychology.
protocol.old_direct_reference: Existing identical label-only prompt hashes may be compared descriptively; no mixing old model batches into contemporaneous randomized contrasts.
limits: Four previously inspected development months; not independent validation.
A conditional reconstruction with real historical priors, not autonomous B forecasting.
24-person subset per month is not a national probability sample.
Label versus detailed arms differ in information quantity and include two extra financial items; not a pure wording effect.
Actual incorrect quiz answers are persona evidence; adding them can itself expose numerical anchors. Effects do not prove a human cognitive mechanism.
Two generations measure API variability, not two independent respondents or provider-fixed sampling seeds.
Both model and observed ten-bin answers use the same frozen approximate Q9 fitter. Official derived fields are auxiliary fitting diagnostics, not mixed into the primary score.
Past CE and historical-answer availability follow the existing A protocol and are not newly certified strict B inputs.

metric_units.probability_tv_pct: probability percentage points: 0.5 × sum of absolute differences across the ten Q9 bins; not inflation percentage points

kernel_migration.equivalence_check: 3,741 sealed holdout rows recomputed; zero per-field difference

scorer_provenance.approximation_notice: Research approximation of the Armantier et al. (2017) Appendix C generalized-beta fit, selected on a preregistered holdout; not the official FRBNY implementation. The same algorithm scores real and simulated questionnaires; differences from official headline values are reported separately.

human_truth_scoring: Current human ten-bin Q9 vectors are independently rescored with the same frozen approximate fitter used for model vectors; probability-TV compares the raw ten-bin vectors directly.

q9_mean.interpretation: Sensitivity diagnostic only; official summary fields do not replace ten-bin truth or frozen-scorer metrics.

q9_iqr.interpretation: Sensitivity diagnostic only; official summary fields do not replace ten-bin truth or frozen-scorer metrics.

common_support.support_definition: Q9 requires all three arms and both repeats to have finite frozen-scorer density mean/IQR/zero-deflation and finite matched truth; Q8 uses an independent all-arm/all-repeat finite-point mask. No invalid response is repaired or treated as zero.

aggregation: Each month×repeat cell is scored separately; cell summaries then receive equal weight. Repeats are not combined into synthetic respondent answers. Bootstrap resamples respondent clusters globally and carries all their months/repeats together.

sampling_design.reason: Fixed in the protocol to ensure mechanism coverage because Low cases are scarce in the frozen 48-person parent rosters; selection did not use current Q8/Q9 outcomes.
sampling_design.primary_analysis: Unweighted paired person-month analysis with equal month and repeat cells; conditional on this selected roster, not a national estimate.
sampling_design.auxiliary_weighting: Descriptive sensitivity only: raw parent SCE survey weight multiplied by parent-stratum size / selected-stratum size. This does not create a nationally representative cognition sample.

auxiliary_survey_weighted.weight_definition: Parent SCE survey weight × parent-stratum size / selected-stratum size; descriptive sensitivity only.

monthly_mean_bin_distributions.unit: probability percentage points by Q9 bin; each vector is an average across matched people
monthly_mean_bin_distributions.interpretation: Cell-level mean-bin curves are descriptive plot inputs. They do not create pooled respondent answers; repeat cells remain separate.

faithful_paraphrase_minus_question_answe.scope: Exploratory paired respondent-cluster bootstrap; same person retains all months and both repeats; month and repeat cells equally weighted; no multiplicity adjustment.

question_answer_minus_label_only.scope: Exploratory paired respondent-cluster bootstrap; same person retains all months and both repeats; month and repeat cells equally weighted; no multiplicity adjustment.

faithful_paraphrase_minus_label_only.scope: Exploratory paired respondent-cluster bootstrap; same person retains all months and both repeats; month and repeat cells equally weighted; no multiplicity adjustment.

question_answer_minus_label_only.interpretation: A pilot continuation screen only; not a confirmed or overall mechanism-success claim.

faithful_paraphrase_minus_label_only.interpretation: A pilot continuation screen only; not a confirmed or overall mechanism-success claim.

gate_scope: A passing detailed-vs-label pilot gate is only a continuation signal; it is not a confirmed mechanism success. The primary paraphrase-vs-question-answer contrast is reported separately and has no adoption gate.
limitations: Four previously inspected development months and a 24-person selected subsample per month; no independent validation or national inference.
The observed-person Q9 IQR is itself produced by the frozen approximate density scorer; matching inherits its approximation error.

The published Q9_mean/Q9_iqr cache fields can differ from the pinned frozen-scorer values; they are shown only as sensitivity diagnostics. The matched Q9 bin vectors are the direct truth for probability-TV and the same frozen scorer is applied to model and human bins for mean/IQR metrics.
Q9 common-support accuracy is conditional on all arms and repeats being scorable; coverage is reported on every assigned call to expose selection.
High/Low subgroup summaries are descriptive and have no significance tests.
